name: Harold Boulton
bio: Harold Edwin Boulton (1859-1935), a Balliol undergraduate from 1878 who edited Waifs and Strays, in which Wilde published two poems, and who wrote the words of 'The Skye Boat Song'. He succeeded his father as second baronet in 1918. Four of Wilde's letters to him survive from his Oxford years, and the first of them is a complaint that he has not written and that he seems to prefer somebody else's company.
